# A generated file of the build directory has the name @build/ and its path in
# the build directory, and the row `quarantine @build/` quarantines it.  The
# contract rule and the opt-out regions apply to it too.  A build directory
# outside the root gives the same name, and a table with no row for @build/
# refuses the generated file.  The build directory of the tree is
# planted-build, because .gitignore holds each directory with the name build.

# A region of a generated file opts out its specifier, and the other one is an error.
compile error generated_unit.cpp mode=error build=planted-build out=no
flag error -fcontracts
exit error fail
error error planted-build/Generated.h:5 | the 'pre' contract specifier is not permitted in this tree
error error planted-build/Generated.h:6 | quarantine: raw-pointer-object generated_pointer;
error error planted-build/Generated.h:7 | quarantine: raw-pointer-object generated_expanded_pointer;

# The place in a generated macro on line 7 is a place of the generated file.
compile report generated_unit.cpp build=planted-build
flag report -fcontracts
exit report fail
finding report quarantine region @build/Generated.h:2:1 | PROBE: a generated header that the test needs
finding report quarantine opted-out @build/Generated.h:3:32 | contract-specifier pre
finding report contract-specifier contract-specifier @build/Generated.h:5:32 | pre
finding report quarantine raw-pointer-object @build/Generated.h:6:14 | generated_pointer
finding report quarantine raw-pointer-object @build/Generated.h:7:33 | generated_expanded_pointer
error report planted-build/Generated.h:5 | the 'pre' contract specifier is not permitted in this tree

# An unclosed region of a generated file is an error in each mode.
compile unclosed-error unclosed_unit.cpp mode=error build=planted-build out=no
exit unclosed-error fail
error unclosed-error {repo}/include/foundation/Quarantine.h:* | this 'CRUCIBLE_I_KNOW_WHAT_IM_DOING' region has no 'CRUCIBLE_END_I_KNOW_WHAT_IM_DOING'

compile unclosed-report unclosed_unit.cpp build=planted-build out=no
exit unclosed-report fail
error unclosed-report {repo}/include/foundation/Quarantine.h:* | this 'CRUCIBLE_I_KNOW_WHAT_IM_DOING' region has no 'CRUCIBLE_END_I_KNOW_WHAT_IM_DOING'

# A build directory outside the root names its generated file @build/Generated.h too.
compile outside outside_generated_unit.cpp build=../outside-build
flag outside -fcontracts -iquote ..
exit outside fail
finding outside quarantine region @build/Generated.h:2:1 | PROBE: a generated header that the test needs
finding outside quarantine opted-out @build/Generated.h:3:32 | contract-specifier pre
finding outside contract-specifier contract-specifier @build/Generated.h:5:32 | pre
finding outside quarantine raw-pointer-object @build/Generated.h:6:14 | generated_pointer
error outside ../outside-build/Generated.h:5 | the 'pre' contract specifier is not permitted in this tree

compile unrowed generated_unit.cpp rules=rules-without-build.txt build=planted-build out=no
flag unrowed -fcontracts
exit unrowed fail
error unrowed generated_unit.cpp:* | quarantine: no layer row and no quarantine row of the rule table holds '@build/Generated.h'
error unrowed planted-build/Generated.h:5 | the 'pre' contract specifier is not permitted in this tree

# No out= here: a plugin that accepts the directory must not replace the report of the unit.
compile missing generated_unit.cpp build=missing out=no
exit missing fail
error missing - | quarantine: the build directory 'missing' of '-fplugin-arg-crucible_quarantine-build=PATH' does not exist
error missing - | failed to initialize plugin {plugin}
